title: The Emerging AI Paper-Review Arms Race: Adversarial Co-Evolution in Scholarly Publishing
abstract: arXiv:2609.07713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative and agentic AI are reshaping both the production and evaluation of scientific research. These developments are often studied separately, as questions of how AI can produce research and how AI can review it. We argue that this separation misses an increasingly important feature of scholarly publishing: changes on one side alter the incentives, constraints, and behavior of the other. We synthesize 230 scholarly publications and institutional records using a taxonomy of six connected dynamics: production scaling, evaluation automation, evaluation manipulation, defense mechanisms and policy responses, evasion and side effects, and long-horizon ecosystem feedback. translated_title: 新兴的AI论文-评审军备竞赛：学术出版中的对抗性协同进化
translated_abstract: 生成式与智能体AI正在重塑科学研究的生产与评估方式。这些发展通常被分开研究，即作为“AI如何产出研究”和“AI如何评审研究”两个独立问题。我们认为这种割裂忽视了学术出版中一个日益重要的特征：一方的变化会改变另一方的激励、约束和行为。本文综合分析了230篇学术出版物和机构记录，构建了一个包含六种相互关联动态的分类体系：生产规模化、评估自动化、评估操纵、防御机制与政策响应、规避行为与副作用，以及长期生态系统反馈。相关文献揭示了一种正在出现的演进过程：更廉价、更快速的研究生产加大了评估压力，AI介导的评估变得更具可扩展性和可重复性，参与者能够利用评估器的规律性，而机构则以技术手段（评估机制和政策）作出回应。
tldr: 该论文综合230篇文献提出，AI驱动的科研生产与AI辅助的论文评审之间正在形成对抗性协同进化的军备竞赛，一方的变化会重塑另一方的激励、约束与行为，并以六种相互关联的动态刻画了这一不断演变的学术出版生态系统。
en_tdlr: This paper synthesizes 230 scholarly publications to reveal an emerging adversarial co-evolution arms race between AI-driven research production and AI-assisted review, where changes on one side reshape the incentives, constraints, and behavior of the other across six interconnected dynamics.
